content:
WARNING: Deleting an integration from Duo can block user logins!
Be sure to remove Duo authentication from your product's configuration
before you delete the corresponding integration.
Depending on the application this could mean uninstalling Duo software
from your systems, or updating your device or application settings to no
longer include Duo in the authentication process.
There is no way to restore an integration deleted in error with Admin API.
Delete the integration with integration_key  from the system. Attempting to delete
the Admin API integration whose secret key is used to sign this request will return an
error. Requires "Grant applications" API permission.
